source.title: WAC Leader Announcement (August 2026)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

We are happy to announce that Glenn Koster will become the new Leader of the WCA Appeals Committee (WAC). Glenn was already working as a Senior Member of the WAC.

<!-- break -->
Glenn was selected by the WCA Board and approved in a vote, as described in Section 5 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf) about WCA Committees and Teams. This appointment is effective as of August 26, 2026.

We thank Rui Reis, who will remain as a Senior Member of WAC, for the work he has done as the Leader, and wish Glenn the best of luck in fulfilling his new duties.

Glenn’s application was the only one received. You can view Glenn’s candidacy document [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/197lt-fxEy7cyjoWST_1xMZUO9J8uFukX?usp=sharing).

translation.title: WAC 负责人任命公告（2026 年 8 月）
translation.content:
亲爱的 WCA 社区成员：

我们很高兴地宣布，Glenn Koster 将担任 WCA 申诉委员会（WAC）的新任负责人。Glenn 此前已是 WAC 的资深成员。

WCA 董事会依据《WCA 委员会与团队[议案](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2025.0%2520-%2520Committees%2520and%2520Teams.pdf)》第 5 节，选出 Glenn，并通过投票批准了这一任命。任命自 2026 年 8 月 26 日生效。

我们感谢 Rui Reis 担任负责人期间所做的工作。他将继续留任 WAC 资深成员。我们也祝 Glenn 在新的岗位上一切顺利。

我们只收到了 Glenn 的申请。其申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/197lt-fxEy7cyjoWST_1xMZUO9J8uFukX?usp=sharing)查看。
